choose.when: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{date}, '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AS TIME, IFNULL(SUM(), 0) AS sales_volume FROM t_order o WHERE o.pay_time >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{date}, ' ', #{settleTime}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.pay_time < CONCAT(#{date}, ' ', #{settleTime}) AND o.merchantId = '1' AND o.transac_status = 'success' AND (o.order_receiving IN ('rec_order', 'off_order') OR o.order_receiving IS NULL) AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.payment_method = #{payment_method} GROUP BY #{date}
choose.otherwise:
SELECT time_label AS TIME, SUM(daily_total) AS sales_volume FROM ( SELECT settlement_date,
DATE_FORMAT(settlement_date, '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') DATE_FORMAT(settlement_date, '%Y-%m-01 00:00:00') DATE_FORMAT(settlement_date, '%Y-01-01 00:00:00') DATE_FORMAT(settlement_date, '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AS time_label, daily_total FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN TIME(o.pay_time) >= #{settleTime} THEN DATE_ADD(DATE(o.pay_time), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ELSE DATE(o.pay_time) END AS settlement_date, SUM() AS daily_total FROM t_order o WHERE o.merchantId = '1' AND o.transac_status = 'success' AND (o.order_receiving IN ('rec_order', 'off_order') OR o.order_receiving IS NULL) AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.payment_method = #{payment_method} GROUP BY CASE WHEN TIME(o.pay_time) >= #{settleTime} THEN DATE_ADD(DATE(o.pay_time), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ELSE DATE(o.pay_time) END ) daily ) agg GROUP BY time_label ORDER BY time_label DESC
LIMIT 7 LIMIT 12 OFFSET 1 LIMIT 5 OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

mapper.select:
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(), 0) AS business_revenue_net, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(o.refund_amount, 0)), 0) AS total_refund_amount, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(o.discount_amount, 0)), 0) AS total_discount_amount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.payment_method LIKE '%微信收款码%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%wechat_qr%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%offline_wechat%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%微信码%') THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(o.pay_amount_wechat, 0) END), 0) AS pay_channel_wechat, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.payment_method LIKE '%微信收款码%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%wechat_qr%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%offline_wechat%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%微信码%') THEN IFNULL(o.pay_amount_wechat, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pay_channel_wechat_qr, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.payment_method LIKE '%支付宝收款码%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%alipay_qr%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%offline_alipay%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%支付宝码%') THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(o.pay_amount_alipay, 0) END), 0) AS pay_channel_alipay, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.payment_method LIKE '%支付宝收款码%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%alipay_qr%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%offline_alipay%' OR o.payment_method LIKE '%支付宝码%') THEN IFNULL(o.pay_amount_alipay, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pay_channel_alipay_qr, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(o.pay_amount_balance, 0)), 0) AS pay_channel_balance, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(o.pay_amount_cash, 0)), 0) AS pay_channel_cash, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(o.pay_amount_gift, 0)), 0) AS pay_channel_gift, COUNT(o.id) AS paid_order_count FROM t_order o WHERE COALESCE(o.pay_time, o.order_time) >= #{startTime} AND COALESCE(o.pay_time, o.order_time) < #{endTime} AND o.merchantId = '1' AND o.transac_status = 'success' AND (o.order_receiving IN ('rec_order', 'off_order') OR o.order_receiving IS NULL)
AND o.shop_id = #{shopId}
